notes: The four component fields are disjoint as reported by the API: input_tokens excludes cached input, so each token is counted exactly once.
thinking_tokens is a SUBSET of output_tokens and is reported separately, never added into total_tokens.
One API response is written as several assistant transcript lines sharing one requestId and one identical usage object; only the first is counted.
Monetary cost is out of scope. Context-window size, subscription limits and token consumption are three different things.

cost_state_supplement.note: Usage for sessions that have no usage-bearing assistant lines, recovered from Claude Code cost-state records. Reported separately and deliberately NOT added to project_summary: it comes from a different, inconsistently written source. Add it manually only when you state which source each figure came from.

covered: Every API request recorded in this project’s local Claude Code transcripts, including the session that built this tracker.
Subagent (sidechain) requests, read from <sessionId>/subagents/agent-*.jsonl and attributed to their parent session. Collector 1.0.0 did not read these; see docs/token-tracking.md.
not_covered: Subscription-level consumption shown by the interactive /usage view (not machine-readable).
Work done in other project directories (deliberately excluded; see docs/token-tracking.md).
Any session whose transcript was pruned, rotated or never written. Record these in tracking/manual-sessions.md.
Session end timestamps are the last observed request, not a session-close event; Claude Code writes no close record.
